name: Guangdong Shenglu Telecommunication Tech. Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Shenglu Telecommunication Tech. Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and sells antennas and RF products in China and internationally. The company offers microwave antennas and accessories, including rectangular and elliptical waveguides, connectors, and microwave communication antenna accessories; base station antennas, such as multibeam, omnidirectional, sector, and small cell; and automotive antennas comprising GPS, AM/FM, and GNNS and DAB.
